correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_census.py (stdlib-only independent replay): n=4: 6 rows OK, n=5: 21 rows OK, n=6: 112 rows OK, VERIFY PASS, phi-witnesses exactly {n4-002}, {n5-016,n5-017}, {n6-101,n6-106,n6-108}. Independently cross-checked every row with numpy roots: all 129 exponential rows have smallest positive root strictly inside (0,1) with tau inside listed [tau_lo,tau_hi]; all 10 finite/subexponential rows have no root strictly inside (0,1); max interval width ~1.5e-11 (claim <=1e-6). Verified Steinberg derivation 1/W=sum(-1)^k c_k t^k/(1+t)^k=M/(1+t)^w, sanity cases (edgeless, single edge), exact tie factorizations (1-t)(1-t-t^2)=1-2t+t^3 and (t^2+t-1)^2=1-2t-t^2+2t^3+t^4, and the M(1)==0 boundary: 12 exponential rows have M(1)==0 but a smaller root in (0,1) (e.g. n5-012: (1-t)(1-2t), min root 1/2), correctly classed exponential because scripts require hi<1 for the smallest-root enclosure; pure (1-t)^k rows (2 at n=4, 2 at n=5, 3 at n=6) correctly classed subexponential with tau=1. Minimality gap verified: every non-witness exponential row has tau_lo>=2.0, witnesses enclose phi=1.6180339887..., gap 0.382 with disjoint enclosures.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Kolpakov-Talambutsa (1809.09591) proves every infinite RACG/RAAG spherical/geodesic rate is Perron or 1 with no per-graph rational series or ranking; Terragni (1312.3437) proves diagram-order monotonicity and universal lower bound ~1.13 (degree-127 Perron) with no exact per-graph rates or minimizer; Terragni dataset (1503.08764) tabulates Poincare series/rates only for prec-minimal hyperbolic Coxeter systems, a disjoint object class from connected-graph RACGs. None records or mechanically implies the uniform clique-parabolic Steinberg table over all 6+21+112 graphs, the exact M polynomials, the per-stratum phi witnesses, or the 2.0 next-rate gap; values require per-graph computation, not derivation from general theorems. Oh/Salem-asymptotic and Kellerhals hyperbolic-minima lines are likewise existence/bound results on different strata.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object: complete Steinberg rational growth series (1+t)^w/M(t) plus certified tau intervals for the full census strata n=4 (6 graphs) and n=5 (21 graphs) and n=6 (112 graphs) of connected RACGs, with per-stratum minimal exponential rate phi=(1+sqrt5)/2 on named witnesses and certified gap to next rate 2.0. Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the recognized Coxeter-growth/minimal-growth program; values were not known and are not mechanically implied; a future researcher can reasonably need the precise M polynomials, rates, and witness graphs as test/benchmark data for minimal-growth, monotonicity, and software checks. This exceeds the pre-registered fallback (full 4-5 plus 6-vertex sample intervals). Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: every row carries an exact rational function plus enclosure, ties proved by displayed factorization, minimality by disjoint intervals.

decisive_checks: Executed inputs/artifacts/verify_census.py: 6+21+112 rows replay OK, phi-witnesses exactly as claimed, fails=[] -> VERIFY PASS.

Independent numpy-roots cross-check on all 139 rows: exponential rows' 1/min-positive-root lies in listed [tau_lo,tau_hi]; non-exponential rows have no root strictly inside (0,1); max width ~1.5e-11 <= 1e-6.

Hand-verified Steinberg algebra, sanity cases (edgeless, single edge), tie factorizations (1-t)(1-t-t^2) and (t^2+t-1)^2, and M(1)==0 boundary cases (e.g. n5-012 has roots 1/2 and 1, min root 1/2 -> exponential).
Sorted tau_lo per stratum: witnesses at phi, min non-witness tau_lo = 2.0 in each stratum (gap 0.382); regime counts 1/2/3, 1/2/18, 1/3/108 (finite/subexp/exp).
residual_risks: Completeness (6/21/112 types) rests on brute-force bitmask-plus-permutation canonical enumeration in steinberg_census.py matching OEIS A001349; the independent verifier checks distinctness and canonical minimality of the listed rows but does not re-enumerate all masks from scratch.

Sturm open-interval counts at the endpoint t=1 for the 12 exponential rows with M(1)==0 rely on the hi<1 smallest-root assertion plus numeric agreement; a fully formal Sturm-theorem audit of the endpoint convention was not separately mechanized.

Perron/Salem arithmetic of individual rates is explicitly disclaimed (only enclosures plus exact factors where stated) and word-length scope is spherical only; both are stated limitations, not headline claims.
